messages:
ellie.varma: Quick brain-dump — thinking about a small feature in Console: run a fuzzy classifier on SLO alerts to suppress obvious noise, and hook its decision into notify routing + quota backpressure. want quick takes before I write an RFC.

samir: Short version: how does this change who gets paged vs who gets a tenant-only notification?

ellie.varma: Good call. Proposal: classifier votes on suppress|deliver. If suppress -> send as low-priority tenant notification (no pager) unless error_budget_exceeded OR quota_backpressure=true, then escalate to pager. Also keep raw alerts in telemetry for eval.

tia: UI request: need per-tenant sensitivity controls + a preview mode — teams should be able to preview what would have been suppressed for their tenants.

mike: Concern: new tenants might be under-observed; fuzzy suppressor could hide regressions. Recommend canary rollout: 5% of alerts for a service go through classifier, but keep primary routing until we validate FN/FPos.

ellie.varma: +1 to canary. Also plan to emit metrics we can query: slo.suppression.decision_total, slo.suppression.false_negatives_estimate, notify.routed_to_pager_total.

ellie.varma: Draft config sketch: 
```
notify_policy:
  classifier:
    type: fuzzy
    sensitivity: per_tenant  # global|per_tenant|service
    threshold: 0.65         # probability cutoff
    fallback: pager_on_error_budget_exceeded
```

samir: From API side we need a small contract change. Suggest: POST /api/v1/notify/policies.apply with new fields (classifier.*) and GET /api/v1/telemetry/suppression-preview?tenant_id=... for previews. Keep it opt-in via feature_flag.

platform-bot: deploy-preview: canary-stack build 2024-11-07-rc3 available at https://canary.console/dev — includes classifier prototype. :robot_face:

tia: Console UX notes: slider for sensitivity values, a toggle for "simulate only" that writes simulation events to a dataset for 30 days, and a one-click "run historical preview" that runs the classifier against the last 7 days of alerts.

oncall-rotation: From oncall POV: must have a hard override per-service that forces pager routing, and all suppression decisions must be auditable (who toggled, timestamp, reason). Also want an always-panic-mode that ignores suppression if SLO breach > X%.

devex: For docs/SDK: we should version the policy API and add examples. e.g. `curl -X POST /api/v1/notify/policies.apply -d '{"classifier":{"type":"fuzzy","threshold":0.7}}'` and a migration guide for existing notify configs.

ellie.varma: Plan for RFC: problem statement, classifier model/heuristics, API contract changes, Console UX mocks (preview + slider), telemetry dashboards (queries + alerting on suppression false-negative trends), rollout plan (canary -> 25% -> global), rollback criteria, and automation for per-tenant sensitivity. I'll ping with draft later this week.

mike: +1 to RFC. Also: include a simple offline test harness so infra can replay historical signals against the classifier.

samir: I'll stub the API surface and add the feature_flag gate. Will wait for RFC before impl.

ellie.varma: OK thanks all — sending RFC draft by EOD Thu. reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:
